description: This Java interface defines a visitor pattern for traversing JSON values, including handling nulls, booleans, strings, numbers, arrays, and objects, with methods to process each type and a default evaluation method.

classes.name: JsonObjectVisitor
classes.description: A package-private interface implementing a visitor pattern for JSON data types, allowing specific handling of different JSON value types.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Handles JSON null values for a given key.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Handles JSON boolean values for a given key.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Handles JSON string values for a given key.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Handles JSON number values for a given key.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Handles JSON array values for a given key.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Handles JSON object values for a given key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JsonValue, dispatching to the appropriate handling method based on the value's type.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Determines the type of the JsonValue and invokes the corresponding method to process it.
